story.title: Our Story
story.description: Discover Camp Bali's journey, from a family move to Bali in 2005 to pioneering Virgin Coconut Oil and building partnerships with village communities.
story.intro: A family move to Bali became a journey into natural products, local partnerships, and a belief in growing together.
story.productImageAlt: A glass bottle of coconut oil with a wooden cap beside a halved coconut on a stone surface
story.closing: From our first Virgin Coconut Oil to the collection we make today, our story continues with the communities we work alongside.
origins: The story of Camp Bali started nearly two decades ago when our family made a life-changing move to Bali. Seeking an escape from the rat race, we wanted our three children to deeply connect with their Indonesian roots. While our initial plan was to establish an IT business, high internet costs at the time led us in a new direction.

Partnering with the Bali Appropriate Technology Institute through our company, Consultek, we set out to produce and market high-quality Virgin Coconut Oil (VCO). We were proud pioneers as the first VCO producers in Bali, and reaching the shelves of Bali Buddha marked a major milestone. Over the years, we have expanded into a variety of oils, natural foods, and spa products, with VCO remaining the core of our brand.

timeline.title: Sustainable Futures

ethos.title: Our Ethos: Aid Through Business
ethos.description: Explore Camp Bali's belief in Aid Through Business: natural products, direct village partnerships, and sustainable livelihoods for rural Indonesian communities.
ethos.heroIntro: We make natural products with a simple belief: business can help rural communities thrive.
ethos.heroImageAlt: Coconut palms above rice terraces in the soft morning mist in Bali
ethos.pillarsIntro: Three principles guide the way we source, create, and work with the communities around us.
ethos.closingText: Explore the oils and natural pantry products that have grown from our village partnerships.
ethos.intro: We operate on a simple yet powerful conviction: "Aid through Business." We actively partner with local growers, farmers, and artisans across village communities, sourcing raw ingredients and manufacturing locally whenever possible. By supporting sustainable business models, we help strengthen rural economies and empower local communities.
ethos.mission: To create high-quality, pure natural oils and wellness products while nurturing sustainable livelihoods for rural Indonesian communities.

pillars.title: Aid Through Business
pillars.text: Empowering rural families through fair commerce rather than charity.
pillars.detail: We build commercial partnerships with village producers, so creating natural products also supports local livelihoods. This is the belief behind Aid Through Business.

pillars.title: Community Sourcing
pillars.text: Partnering directly with local growers and producers to keep revenue inside village economies.
pillars.detail: Wherever possible, we source ingredients and manufacture locally. Working closely with growers, farmers, and artisans helps keep more of the value within village economies.

pillars.title: Sustainable Innovation
pillars.text: Developing new products that breathe life into traditional farming communities.
pillars.detail: We continue developing oils, natural foods, and wellness products that connect traditional ingredients with new opportunities for rural communities.

questions.question: How do I ask for product prices?
questions.answer: Choose products and sizes in our catalogue and add them to My List. You can send that list on WhatsApp so our team can confirm prices and availability.

questions.question: Can I ask about wholesale or reselling?
questions.answer: Yes. Select Wholesale & reselling in the form and tell us about your business, the products you are interested in and the quantities you have in mind.

questions.question: Does this form send my message automatically?
questions.answer: The form prepares a WhatsApp draft using the details you enter. You can review or edit the message in WhatsApp and choose when to send it.
